title: SigHearth task hearth
description: The Signature Task Hearth is a Signature original: a distributed task queue where decorated Python functions become background jobs routed through brokers to worker fleets, with canvas-style composition, beat scheduling, and result backends — the Signature take on async work. Its protocol, canvas, and observability are original Signature designs.

demo.program:
print('@hearth.task\ndef job(): ...  # .later() queues it')
print('edition: Signature original')
